technical-summary: A start with no live placement policy now says why. derive_manifest_live_policy sets a skip reason for a missing calibration store and for a missing record under the configuration's calibration key (recorded on /spec/handoff/placement), and the launcher prints one 'live placement: ON (...)' or 'OFF -- reason' line read from the manifest it will use. A plan-key change that orphaned the flashnext-4gpu record had left every start without a policy silently. Test derive_says_why.
user-summary-candidate: Starting the server now tells you plainly whether live expert placement is on, and if not, why.
